flags.why: The example defines an intransitive verb instead of showing the term in use.
flags.fix: Trong câu này, “ngủ” là động từ bất cập vật. = In this sentence, “ngủ” is an intransitive verb.

flags.why: The word means inseparable from one's person, not simply essential or crucial, as illustrated in this [dictionary](https://dokumen.pub/vietnamese-english-dictionary.html).
